verdict.rationale: The product's documentation is served in agent-friendly formats: a probe confirms llms.txt exists and returns HTTP 200 with a documentation summary, and individual doc pages are also available as raw .md files with an explicit pointer to the full llms.txt index for agents to fetch. This directly enables an AI agent to be pointed at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs for the Agent SDK. Missing for 10: no first-party statement explicitly marketing llms.txt support as a feature, and no independent report of an agent successfully using it end-to-end.
